description: This file defines the UserService class which provides user management functionalities such as saving, retrieving, deleting users, role management, and password verification within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Provides user management functionalities such as saving, retrieving, deleting users, role management, and password verification within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: geUserDao
methods.description: Returns the UserDao instance, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: getPasswordHasher
methods.description: Returns the PasswordHash instance, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: saveSystemUser
methods.description: Saves or updates a system User, handling password hashing if required.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Retrieves a system User based on user ID.

methods.name: deleteSystemUsers
methods.description: Performs soft deletion of users by IDs.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves a UserRole object based on role name.

methods.name: getSearchSystemUsersCount
methods.description: Returns count of users based on search filter.

methods.name: searchSystemUsers
methods.description: Searches for users based on filter parameters.

methods.name: isCurrentPassword
methods.description: Verifies if provided password matches the current password of the user.

methods.name: getEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves employees assigned to a specific user role, with options to include inactive or terminated employees.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns the User object if successful.

methods.name: checkPasswordHash
methods.description: Verifies a password against a hash.

methods.name: checkForOldHash
methods.description: Checks if a password matches an old hash format (MD5).

methods.name: getUndeletableUserIds
methods.description: Returns list of user IDs that cannot be deleted, such as current user and default admin in demo mode.
